segs.text: And I'm Mr. Cosmo! Welcome back to our space classroom!
Remember Emma's family? Let's say their names!
Father, mother, grandfather, grandmother, brother, sister!
Today, we will learn to ask about people. Who's he? Who's she?
今天要學怎麼問「他是誰？」「她是誰？」，還有怎麼回答。
Look! He. He is a boy or a man.
And she. She is a girl or a woman.
男生用 he，就是單人旁的「他」；女生用 she，就是女字旁的「她」。中文唸起來一樣，英文可不一樣喔！

Now, three short words. He is... becomes He's!

segs.text: Look at this man. Who's he?
Who's he? 就是「他是誰？」。問「誰」的問句，句尾語調要往下降。

Repeat after me. He's my father.

segs.text: Game time! Look at Emma's family. You ask, and you answer!
亮起來的是誰？先問「他是誰」或「她是誰」，再回答。
He's my father. Great job, class!
Today we learned two questions. Who's he? Who's she?

segs.text: And the answers. He's my father. She's my mother.
問男生說 Who's he?，回答 He's my 加家人；問女生說 Who's she?，回答 She's my 加家人。記得 Who's、He's、She's 都是縮寫喔！
